notes.title: Mum said its my turn on the Tank
notes.notes:
Are you ready?

Fed up having your bones crushed and eaten up by the vehicles?

Wanna get behind the wheel?

Good.

It's payback time.

I've introduced 4 new vehicles, each with their own character and special abilities. Please, pick your poison...

[b]The APC[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934466/ab0c1a6ce2a9466d2724272374bea4f08d0a4c4a.png[/img]

The armoured personnel carrier, with a machine gun capable of destroying aircraft and infantry it excels in breaking enemy lines and dropping off troops. When needed you can deploy 4 troops in an area to help secure a location. It boasts a missile for a backup in case you ever come into contact with light vehicles.

[b]The Tank[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934466/08e080d23c82f67d86a065bac57792f2ed7a33b5.png[/img]

The apex predator of the battlefield.

With a cannon allowing it to bombard targets from afar, the shells will rip up light vehicle and heavy vehicle alike. Armed with an interchangeable machine gun should you ever feel the need to deal with multiple infantry. Its gas grenades allow a brutal yet effective method of denying the enemy territory in an engagement.

[b]The Skirmisher[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934466/de3d5c713be2e91c591ba8a0aaaffca3bb7d8973.png[/img]

Fast. Agile. Terrifying.

This is an extremely lightly armoured vehicle. Nicknamed 'Glass Cannon' due to its powerful weaponry yet weak armour. If caught off guard it will perish quickly no doubt. However with the ability to deploy suicide bombers and also massive timed bombs, this vehicle can wipe out entire armies on its own.

[b]Rocket Truck[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934466/1148ba48f21c7a99297f9c72a2b4be758df433db.png[/img]

We hope you've brought an umbrella, however it wont do much.

The rocket truck can fire a volley of 12 missiles which will rain down on an area of your choice. Whilst firing it is vulnerable as it cannot move, and you must be zoomed in to fire it. But these twelve missiles prove to be horrific and deadly on any unsuspecting vehicle or camp. With the ability to deploy its own security team, alongside its ability to instantly call in a missile strike. This monster will certainly dominate from afar.

[b]To our infantry[/b]
Please do not despair. We have not forgotten you at all. We are arming you with new weapons as we speak. The AT Frisbee is a one hit kill on any vehicle, so make sure to get your ambushing skills on point. 

Also suicide bombers will instantly destroy any vehicle caught in their blast, so keep your eyes peeled for any lovely opportunities.

Anyway that's all for this round folks, please have fun and happy hunting!

Yaz

notes.title: Requested features
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is my first game, I really have a passion for making games part time. I really want to hear what you guys think I should add to Razed Earth. 

This is a game that I want to build up over time, and I want you guys to feel a part of its development as much as I do.

So please if you see something you'd like to add, ask me and I'll definitely see what I can do :)

Thank you for your continued support, even with the teething issues. You guys are helping me so much in building a future for not just this game but future ones too. So I thank you for your patience and support. It means literally the world to me.

As always,
Yaz
Lone Razed Earth Developer

notes.title: The Tanks are here
notes.notes:
Do you hear that? Its the sound of change.

The tanks have arrived and they do not take prisoners. They will slaughter their way through hundreds of unsuspecting victims. Mercy is not a word in their vocabulary. Although they take a real beating, an air strike is a truly devastating strike on them. 

To help us combat the new threat, we've issued some lovely new weaponry. Find the RPG in the loadout menu now and take your ambushing skills to new heights.

Happy hunting!

Yaz

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934466/d3cce785a4c5e9f75440eef858b0efff09b25c25.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Hello All! 

Thank you for you kind support, again it means the world to me. I've added a little overhaul of the plane customisation and how the logic for sorting the volleys work, hopefully there should be no further issues with it in the future. 

I've also taken the liberty to add a 3 shot missile barrage, a devastating payload should you be on the wrong end of it. There's also a new paratrooper deployment pod you can place on your plane. If the ground forces require assistance, count on these brave soldiers to dive head first into certain death.

happy hunting!
Yaz

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your support, it means the world to me! I've listened to your feedback and im working on the issues highlighted, involving frame drops and various other graphical issues. The waypoint, ui and various other physical glitches should be gone now. With an added time for waypoints to show imitating getting orientated :)

Again you are all amazing and keep the feedback coming in!

Yaz
